name: Sea Limited
quirks: SEC framed XBRL revenue tag (RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax, CY frames) UNDERSTATES total revenue from FY2023 -- it excludes DFS interest revenue. FY2025 filed total is $22,938m vs $19,625m framed. Use the unframed 'Revenues' tag or the press-release income statement.

Monee (DFS) is an embedded consumer lender: loans receivable ~$9.6bn net, funded partly by deposits payable $4.3bn and escrow payables $3.3bn. Deposits/escrow are NOT net debt; gross cash is NOT all distributable.
Foreign private issuer: 20-F annual + 6-K quarterly earnings releases (financials live in EX-99.1).
